user.title: Pair with a PC
user.description: In the PC Bio Unlock desktop app, start pairing a new device with the TCP method, then enter the details it shows next to the QR code.

data_description.remote_host: IP address of the PC, as shown by the PC Bio Unlock desktop app.
data_description.bind_ip: IP address of Home Assistant, which the PC sends its unlock requests to.
data_description.pair_port: Pairing port shown by the desktop app.
data_description.encryption_key: Encryption key shown by the desktop app.

reconfigure.title: Update the IP addresses
reconfigure.description: Update the IP addresses if the PC or Home Assistant changed address. The PC stays paired.

data_description.remote_host: IP address of the PC, as shown by the PC Bio Unlock desktop app.
data_description.bind_ip: IP address of Home Assistant, which the PC sends its unlock requests to.

error.pairing_refused: The PC refused the pairing. Check the encryption key, and that the desktop app is waiting for a pairing.
error.timeout: Timeout while pairing with the PC.

no_unlock_server.message: No unlock server is running for {name}.
